text: Risk management is the process of identifying possible problems before they happen. First, you need to find the risks that could affect your project, such as delays, high costs, or technical failures. After identifying risks, you develop mitigation strategies to reduce their impact. For example, you might train staff or buy extra equipment. It is also wise to create contingency plans, which are backup solutions if things go wrong. Finally, you must monitor risks regularly, because new risks can appear at any time. Good risk management helps you stay calm and solve problems quickly when they arise.
